title: Interpretable deep learning for depression detection in neurological patients using EEG signals.
summary: The primary full text reports a defined retrospective clinical classification task: EEG-based depression detection in neurological patients. CNN classification of extracted EEG features is tested on 70 held-out cases with reported 98% accuracy and cross-validation; the claim is limited to this dataset and is not evidence of clinical benefit or general deployment.
ai_technology: Primary full text, Methods and Results (PMID 41438403; PMCID PMC12720302). It uses a public EEG depression-feature dataset; test sample 70, accuracy 98%, cross-validation 97.6±1.2%. Narrow retrospective diagnostic validation; no clinical-utility claim.
